versions.content: If the call to the ProtectionHook is caused by a trusted function which causes a E_OS_PROTECTION_EXCEPTION or E_OS_PROTECTION_MEMORY , the only valid return value shall be PRO_SHUTDOWN . Returning other values shall also result in a shutdown of the OS.
